blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: Insert — Adds at a specified index.
Count — Number of items currently stored.

blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: List<T> is a resizable sequence. Add appends; Insert inserts at a specified index and shifts following items.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: RemoveAt removes an item by index; Remove(value) removes the first matching value instead.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Unlike an array, List<T> changes Count as items are inserted/removed. An index must still be within the valid bounds.

questions.feedback: Insert — Adds at a specified index.

blocks.title: Trace and justify
blocks.text: [3,9,12]. Add appends 12; Remove(6) removes matching value 6, unlike RemoveAt(6).
